text:
morgan: scheduling a late-window kernel + quant push tonight 02:15 UTC: kernel v2.15.2 + quant qf-2026-05. Plan: tiny canary (0.25%) -> 2% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100%, with 6m holds. auto-pin if client 5xx >0.25% for 5m. Cross-region swap requires Leo or me to ack. Preflight at 01:40 UTC.

deploybot: job=deploy-5219990001 created; preflight scheduled 01:40 UTC. Will run prebake, smoke, quick perf bench. Use /status to check.

daria: heads-up	6 small ABI-safe matmul tweak included; should be backward-compatible but we saw one flake in staging where older shard returned slightly different padding behavior. Recommend staging-holder during 15% step.

leo: noted. I'll be on-call for cross-region go/no-go. Ops, are we ready to hold sticky pin for region-eu for 4h if needed?

ops: yes, we can set sticky pin TTL=4h with deploybot on demand. Prepared rollback ticket template and tenant-pin commands.

morgan: RN draft: "v2.15.2: matmul micro-optimizations, improved memory accounting, kv flush ordering fix for rare race, quant numeric stability tweaks." Will post after 60% step.

eng-sre-bot: preflight PASS 01:42 UTC. prebake ok, smoke ok, checksum verified.

deploybot: canary 0.25% started 02:15:06 UTC. metrics: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5219990001. Tagging #eng-runtime and #eng-sre.

daria: running kv-consistency on canary nodes now: `./infra/checks/kv_consistency --targets canary`. Will report within 3-4m.

chris: quick note	 watch for KV write-latency tail; perf bench on medium sequences showed a small p95 bump.

eng-sre-bot: 02:20 UTC check: p99 +3.5% (within gate), 5xx flat, kv-miss +0.03% absolute. clear to proceed to 2% at 02:22 UTC.

deploybot: promoted to 2% 02:22:12 UTC. holding 6m.

ops: no evictions seen. sticky-pin ready.

daria: canary kv suite green. no write races.

morgan: before 15% step well enable staging-holder tag so that customer-critical tenants are excluded from early traffic if needed. Doing that at 02:35 UTC.

leo: I will approve cross-region at 03:10 UTC if metrics remain stable during 60% hold.

eng-sre-bot: 02:30 UTC check: p99 +4.9%, 5xx +0.01% absolute, GPU temp nominal. Proceed to 15%.

deploybot: promoted to 15% 02:36:05 UTC. scheduled 6m hold.

chris: monitoring shows a per-shard p95 jitter on one canary subset. not yet customer-impactful but watching.

morgan: if that jitter correlates with kv-evictions, we will pin region and open rollback. Ops, be ready to execute `deployctl tenant-pin --scope region --kernel v2.14.3` if asked.

ops: acknowledged. rollback ticket prepared.

eng-sre-bot: after 15% hold metrics look stable. promoting to 60% at 02:43:12 UTC.

deploybot: promoted to 60% 02:43:12 UTC. final hold 10m before 100% cutover.

leo: approving cross-region swap pending 03:09 UTC sanity. If anything odd, I'll veto.

chris: 02:50 UTC update: jitter trace narrowed to a specific batcher alignment path; mitigation appears feasible without rollback, but still monitoring.

morgan: OK hold on 100% until Leo approves cross-region. Posting RN draft to #release-notes now.

leo: approve for 100% at 03:09:45 UTC. metrics stable.

deploybot: final promote to 100% completed 03:10:05 UTC. rollout summary: no auto-pins, no rollbacks, sticky pin configured for region-eu if needed. RN: posted. Bake window 30m.

morgan: great work. I'll open a short post-deploy note and assign postmortem stub to Daria for follow-up on batcher jitter root cause. If anything regresses during bake, invoke manual pin and tag this thread.
